/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('/workspace/work/decision.md')
s=p.read_text()
links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((/["'^)]+)'"\\)',s)
missing=[x for x in links if not Path(x).is_file()]
ids=set(re.findall(r'record-[0-9a-f]{10}',s))
source_text='\\n'.join(Path(x).read_text() for x in set(links))
unbacked=sorted(x for x in ids if x not in source_text and not any(x in y for y in links))
print('Decision:',p)
print('Words:',len(s.split()))
print('Source links:',len(links),'Unique:',len(set(links)))
print('Missing source paths:',missing)
print('Unbacked source IDs:',unbacked)
print('Opening:\\n'+'\\n'.join(s.splitlines()[:5]))
assert not missing and not unbacked
PY"
